rules: Do not recommend removing a Mac surface unless dynamic card coverage exists.
Do not recommend converting if action payload or receipt coverage is missing.
Developer Proof stays available but hidden.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep as native Mac shell/controller navigation.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: The app loses its primary control frame even if cards render correctly.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep as native text/input controller; dispatch verified controller events.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: The operator loses the generic command/input surface.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep as native Mac navigation state.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Dynamic cards cannot replace global world/bank selection.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep a generic renderer; remove workflow-specific card classes behind it.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Backend cards exist but have nowhere stable to render.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep native drop/file-picker UX; let backend cards own receipt/status copy.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: The Mac loses local file-intake affordances even though evidence receipts can render.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep generic drawer shell; populate contents from proof objects and meters.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Proof remains generated but not inspectable by the operator.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace workflow-specific payment-watch/status panels with dynamic cards.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Low if generic renderer, proof drawer, and native navigation stay bespoke.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace workflow-specific evidence receipt panel with backend evidence-intake card.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Medium if native drop zone is removed; low for status panel thinning.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace bespoke follow-up/proposal status panel with workflow composer plan card.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Low while send remains blocked and staging remains receipt-backed.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace bespoke packet cards with backend review-packet cards once using review action slots.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Medium if review actions are not routed through deterministic payloads.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep workroom navigation shell; convert packet/status contents after all workroom lanes emit v1 cards.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: High. Workroom shell, routing, and navigation are not just card content.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Render gate/approval states as dynamic cards; never expose protected execution from these cards.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Medium if disabled execution affordances are not preserved.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Use dynamic memory candidate cards for display; keep review controls until promotion actions have parity.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Medium. Candidate display exists, but promotion/rejection control parity is incomplete.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace resolved/test-only bespoke status panel with completed historical receipt card.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Low for resolved history; keep any future active edit controls separate.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Replace bespoke workbook metadata panel with current-focus workbook registration card.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Low if workbook mutation remains blocked and only metadata refs are shown.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep available behind explicit proof-depth/detail opt-in; hide by default.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: High. Operators and developers lose source refs, hashes, and receipt details.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Keep generic drawer shell; convert workflow-specific evidence rows after proof drawer parity.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: Medium. Evidence proof exists, but local file preview and redaction UX must stay intact.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Remove old workflow-specific panels only after card, receipt, proof-drawer, and action parity are confirmed.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: High. Some legacy invoice states may still lack v1 receipt parity.

surface_readiness.recommended_mac_action: Do not build. Incoming authority_granted remains ignored or rejected.
surface_readiness.risk_if_removed_too_early: No removal risk; the surface should not exist.
